tests.recipe: Files: studies/rlneurons/results/wsp1/full500/top8_plain-01/per_problem.json and S3 s3://pg-lineage-769063704696/results/rlneurons/r4/modal_t3-01/t3/T3.jsonl (base, plain, T 1.0; fetch with the aws command in inventory.md). Selected set Q = top8 rows with score_v3 == 0, cap_hit false and n_generated <= 2000 (rows with missing score_v3 left out; each problem_index once, first row in file order). In T3 keep the first row per problem_index and compute its v3 score with studies/rlneurons/grader/rln4_grader_v3.py from text and gold (empty extraction = 0). A T3 row is wrong if its v3 score is 0 or cap_hit is true. Drop problems in Q that have no T3 row. Statistic: (number of problems in Q whose T3 row is wrong) / (number of problems in Q with a T3 row).
tests.note: Files: studies/rlneurons/results/wsp1/full500/top8_plain-01/per_problem.json (500 rows, one per problem, fields problem_index, score_v3, cap_hit, n_generated) and T3.jsonl fetched from s3://pg-lineage-769063704696/results/rlneurons/r4/modal_t3-01/t3/T3.jsonl into runs/theory-tests/s3/r4/modal_t3-01/t3/ (500 rows, one per problem, text always present). The v3 score is computed with rln4_lib.grade_v3(gold, text), the function rln4_grader_v3.py calls; an empty extraction scores 0. The hand-judged flip list in rln4_grader_v3.py (JUDGED_INCORRECT, which includes base_plain_1.0 = T3 problem 146) is not applied, because the recipe says to compute v3 from text and gold. n_generated <= 2000 is taken from the top8 row. The main number counts a T3 row as wrong if v3 == 0 or cap_hit. alt_measured counts it wrong only if v3 == 0 (a cap-hit row with a right box counts as right). Interval: bootstrap over the Q problems that have a T3 row. Some T3 rows have n_generated 1 and an empty text; they score 0 and count as wrong.

tests.experiment: Difficulty-controlled contrast: plain-base T 1.0 wrong rate on top8's quick-wrong problems minus its wrong rate on top8-right problems that the cued base solves in at least 3 of 4 samples.
tests.recipe: Files: studies/rlneurons/results/wsp1/full500/top8_plain-01/per_problem.json, studies/rlneurons/results/day1_3/math500_base_cue-01/rows.jsonl, and S3 r4/modal_t3-01/t3/T3.jsonl. T3: first row per problem_index, v3 recomputed with studies/rlneurons/grader/rln4_grader_v3.py from text and gold; wrong = v3 score 0 or cap_hit true. Group Q = top8 rows with score_v3 == 0, cap_hit false, n_generated <= 2000 (missing score_v3 left out; first row per problem_index). Group C = top8 rows with score_v3 == 1 and cap_hit false whose problem has exactly 4 attempt-0 rows in rows.jsonl with at least 3 of them score_v3 == 1. Problems without a T3 row are dropped from both groups. Statistic: (fraction of Q with T3 wrong) - (fraction of C with T3 wrong).
tests.note: Files: top8_plain-01/per_problem.json, studies/rlneurons/results/day1_3/math500_base_cue-01/rows.jsonl (no text; uses the stored score_v3; attempts 0-2, with restarts after cap hits), and T3.jsonl (fetched as in p1, v3 recomputed with rln4_lib.grade_v3; wrong = v3 0 or cap_hit). Q is as in p1. C = top8 rows with score_v3 1 and cap_hit false whose problem has exactly 4 attempt-0 rows in rows.jsonl, at least 3 of them with score_v3 == 1. Q and C are disjoint. The statistic is frac_wrong(Q) - frac_wrong(C). It is bootstrapped over the union of Q and C problems (not stratified), so group sizes vary between resamples; a resample with an empty group would count that fraction as 0, which is unlikely to matter. alt_measured uses another reading of 'solves in at least 3 of 4 samples': each sample is scored by its final attempt (the highest attempt after restarts), and at least 3 of 4 must be right. Q is unchanged. The JUDGED_INCORRECT hand flips are not applied (see p1).
